newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Keast flows gas, condensate - Woodside.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Keast flows gas, condensate - Woodside.

text.p: Woodside Petroleum Ltd said on Wednesday that the Keast-1 exploration well offshore Western Australia flowed gas at the rate of 20 million cubic feet per day and condensate at the rate of 1,000 barrels per day (bpd) in a production test over a 23 metre interval.
The stabilised flow rate was through 3-1/2-inch tubing and measured at the separator through a 36/64-inch choke, Woodside said.
The test is continuing, it added.
Woodside said tweo weeks ago that logging had confirmed the presence of 76 metres of gross gas column in three separate reservoirs in the Keast well, which is in in permit WA-6L.
WA-6-L is on Australia's North West Shelf.

Equal partners in the North West Shelf project are units of The Broken Hill Pty Co Ltd, The British Petroleum Co Plc, Japan Australia LNG (MiMi) Pty Ltd, a partnership of Mitsui & Co Ltd and Mitsubishi Corp, Chevron Corp, Royal Dutch/Shell Group and Woodside.
